{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Drop the QA rows
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, compute mean age of customers who converted
# Only include rows where converted == 1 and age != -1 (missing)
converted_customers = sales_clean[(sales_clean['converted'] == 1) & (sales_clean['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of QA rows removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (after cleaning): {mean_age_converted}")"}
